connected_contract: Canonical native path and URI codec must preserve absolute root identity through persistence and restore, with explicit platform-aware conversion. Direct native ProjectRoot authority should avoid lossy URI stripping before PathBuf; no compatibilityfallback.
acceptance: Absolute POSIX path persists/restores identical root independent of process cwd; Windows drive/UNC/native separators and URL escaping policy handled by owning path/URI contract. No automatic directory creation/deletion or reset required.
